objective: Execute the supplied D1 rootless migration specification: prove an isolated rootless candidate before preserving/copying state and cutting over; record actual evidence, desired state and local commits.

context.need: Current repository, host, daemon, service and protected data inventory

capabilities: bounded host administration when sudo -n succeeds

allowed: coherent cutover only after full candidate PASS
bounded sudo host actions when noninteractive authentication succeeds
forbidden: disrupt rootful stack before candidate PASS

completion.criterion: All four rootless services preserve native dependencies and retained data identities without rootful socket access
completion.evidence: isolated full candidate and post-cutover health, object bytes, ClickHouse rows and Langfuse roundtrip

completion.criterion: User systemd/linger owns normal operations and rootful duplicate is disabled after acceptance
completion.evidence: unit/linger/group observations and controlled restart evidence

completion.criterion: Repository accurately records desired state, reboot scope, acceptance limitations and local commits
completion.evidence: validation record and local Git history
